title: save.request
description: WORLD_SESSIONS_PLAN §2.4, D5 (WS4): asks the hidden game for a save of its own because Minecraft saves the world (world: the autosave, /save-all; S→C from the server, which the client fans out to its bound links) or leaves it (quit: the client's quit choreography, WS5). gen1-bridge answers act.result{kind:"save", ok, reason?} (reasons: not_ingame, not_idle, vetoed, failed, busy); a written save announces itself as save.begin with this reason.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
